$comment: Structured extraction of the Zip agentic-factory artifact model, transcribed from 'zip  architecture.pdf' (4 scanned pages). This file is the machine-readable source of truth: the HTML presentation and the Markdown docs are both generated from / kept in sync with it. 'attested' means the value is written on the scan; 'inferred' means it was reasoned from context and needs confirmation.

files.covers: setup / environment, the six stages with human gates, open questions Q.1-Q.7
artifacts, negotiation file, agents & rating, documentation loops, control plane, open action items

source.nature: scanned handwritten architecture notes, no text layer
source.page_order_note: zip arc1.pdf is document page 1 and was supplied separately. Its insertion resolves the numbering mismatch: scan page 3 of the 4-page PDF is labelled 'Page 4' by the author, which is correct once page 1 is counted. No page is missing.

setup_environment.$comment: Source: zip arc1.pdf (document page 1). Appears on no other page.

carries.name: Skills Agent

phases.name: Specify
phases.notes: Reads existing documentation as context (upstream documentation loop).

phases.name: Dispatch
phases.notes: Named as a phase with defined personas/sub-processes in Open Action Item 2.

phases.name: Generate
phases.notes: Agents build. Annotated against Project Assignment on page 1.

phases.name: Review

phases.name: Update Documentation

artifacts.label: BRD
artifacts.description: A business-user-level understanding of the LMS component to be designed.

artifacts.label: PRD
artifacts.description: Translates the BRD into a PRD and creates the set of tasks that will be executed.

artifacts.label: Project Assignment
artifacts.description: A service that applies deterministic rules to decide how an agent gets assigned to tasks.

artifacts.label: Handover / Build Report
artifacts.description: A record of what was accomplished, per agent and per task.

artifacts.label: Negotiation File
artifacts.description: A ledger of feedback between Entity A and Entity B, where A and B are each either Human or Agent. Used across different phases.
artifacts.role: side-car ledger - attaches to artifacts, is not a stage in the pipeline

agent_model.cardinality: TO BE DEFINED (explicit note on scan page 2)

registry.shape: 2x2 grid of agents (A1, A2, A3, A4) - illustrative, not a real cardinality
registry.principle: Registry has a deterministic way of choosing agents

record.role: selection criterion the registry keys off

control_plane.approve: control plane -> operator laptop (dashed, human-in-the-loop gate)

downstream.label: As part of Phase 6, or as a parallel Phase 7
downstream.rule: With all artifacts, check what part of functional & technical documentation should be updated.

rules: Check existing documentation to build things in context
